description: Build the v1 MVP of Private Ledger: a self-hosted, privacy-first personal finance app with CSV import, merchant management, budgeting, dashboard analytics, reporting, and secure multi-user household support.

userStories.title: Scaffold deployable FastAPI and React application

acceptanceCriteria: Create FastAPI app entrypoint and mount a compiled frontend asset directory
Create Vite React TypeScript app shell with a placeholder authenticated layout
Add Docker Compose configuration and app container build files
Document local startup command and required environment variables

Tests pass
